title: Incident response: short and long-term containment

videos.script: Containment is stopping the damage from growing, before you fully understand it. {{stop}} It is the first time in a response that somebody changes the systems, and every change moves evidence. So it starts by writing down what would be lost, and only then acts. {{collect}} Then two moves in your own lab. Cut the file server's way out to the internet, except the backup. Block the address the logins came from. {{lab}} Each one is checked, not assumed: what stopped, and what still works. And each has a price: what it breaks, what it tells the other side, and how easily it comes undone. {{price}}
